answer: EigenTrust curbs Sybil attacks by propagating transitive trust scores across peer interaction graphs. Filtering ratings through this topological prism isolates colluding rings, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of securing authentic counterparty history per identity. Even if an agent generates a convincing sonnet, forged clones cannot reach the zenith of trust without organic endorsements. However, this design inherently entrenches incumbent nodes and penalizes new entrants.
